title: Poppy and the happy trolls.
lines: The trolls live in a colourful forest.
They're small, with very tall hair.
Pink hair, blue hair, purple hair.
The trolls are always happy.
They sing, they dance and they hug.
Every hour, on a special watch, it's hug time!
Poppy is the princess of the trolls.
She's pink and she laughs all day.
She makes cards full of glitter for everyone.
But there's one troll who never sings.
His name is Branch.
He's grey and he's always worried.
Branch says: You're singing too loudly.
The Bergens will hear us!
The Bergens are big, grumpy creatures.
They are never happy.
They think they can only be happy if they eat a troll.
Poppy throws a big party.
With lights, glitter and very loud music.
And sure enough.
A Bergen hears it.
She grabs a few trolls and takes them to Bergen Town.
Poppy wants to rescue her friends.
Branch, come with me!
At first Branch doesn't want to.
But then he goes anyway.
They travel through a dark forest.
They see funny spiders and flowers that bite.
Poppy keeps on singing.
Branch rolls his eyes.
In Bergen Town they see a Bergen girl.
Her name is Bridget.
She's the kitchen maid.
She's very sad.
She's in love with the king, but she doesn't dare say anything.
Poppy has an idea.
The trolls make a beautiful wig out of their hair for Bridget.
She looks wonderful.
Bridget goes to the roller rink with the king.
They laugh together.
They eat pizza.
Bridget is happy.
And she hasn't eaten a troll!
Look, says Poppy.
You don't have to eat anyone to be happy.
Happiness is inside you.
The trolls are set free.
Branch is so relieved that he sings.
Suddenly his grey colour turns blue!
All the Bergens and all the trolls dance together.
There's music and glitter everywhere.
And Poppy?
She gives everyone a hug.
Because it's hug time.
The end.
